target.statement: ICS with S1='cov', S2='tcovAxis', algorithm='standard' on the RANDU dataset reveals the hyperplane structure on the last invariant component (Figure 1a), unlike PCA.

compute.basis: Synthetic RANDU data generated in-package; ICS on a small 3D dataset with NumPy/Numba runs in seconds on CPU; only pip install and a short script needed.

title: ICSpyLab: A Python package for invariant coordinate selection
